visualReview.scope: Current exterior render integrity; maximum fidelity remains pending.
visualReview.notes: All14 current portable frames inspected. Five offset decks retain continuous open pedestrian connections, with no coincident overlapping top surfaces. Diamond railings, tapered masts, spreader rings,118 stays and trumpet supports render coherently. Corrected small gaps between curved handrails and shore interface rails before final capture. Thin10mm stays alias in distant portable views; close geometry is preserved.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All14 current world-viewer frames inspected; shore connection and north-up placement additionally inspected at full resolution. Four canonical material graphs are each read once; no per-model images. Shared paint, stainless, wood and fine concrete grain render coherently. Matacryl and gloss calibration remain fidelity limits. Unload leaves zero live model geometry.

geographicReview.notes: North-up flat fixture follows the exact-QID outline, with a deliberately outboard white deck flange.2012 engineer north arrow resolves P1 southwest/P5 northeast. Model uses absolute sea-level datum and preserves submerged pontoon geometry; actual water elevation, quay interfaces and long approach ramps remain unverified.

fidelityReview.notes: Original detailed closed-state exterior.2015 materials and118 total stays are documented; individual mast heights, stay allocation, flange offsets, fine hardware and pontoon dimensions are photographic/design reconstructions. Full maximum-fidelity approval needs as-built dimensions and current site fit. No animation, concealed hydraulics or long quay ramps are claimed. Do not count as complete.
